Fancy, Lifted GMC Sierra Denali HD Rides Classy on Gloss Black Concave Vossen HFX-5 Alloy Wheels
9 photos
Photo: vossen / Instagram
The good folks over at Miami, Florida-based Vossen , a well-known American manufacturer of luxury and performance aftermarket alloy wheels, have gotten their hands on a batch of cool pictures featuring a GMC Sierra Denali HD pickup truck – and it looks pretty spectacular indeed.
General Motors has carefully taken care of the entire full-size pickup truck series this year. Both the regular Chevy Silverado and GMC Sierra 1500 , but also the heavy-duty models, of course. There’s no discrimination, which is a good thing – especially for the customers and enthusiasts.
There are numerous examples, actually: GM Defense morphed a Silverado 3500HD into an autonomous logistics truck platform, but also introduced a brand-new Mongoose 8.3-liter Duramax turbo diesel on the heavy-duty models, complete with 555 hp and a mountain-moving torque of 1,230 lb-ft from the all-new V8. With it, the maximum towing capacity for the Silverado HD and Sierra HD now climbs to no less than 38k pounds
Naturally, the prices also rose accordingly: the 2027 Chevy Silverado HD soars by up to $1,500 for various trims, and the competition-killer 8.3L Duramax alone adds $11,400 before any fees. Of course, many people will actually focus on the regular 1500 versions because there are all-new fifth and sixth generations for the Silverado and Sierra, which come with brand-new design inside and out plus the brand-new 5.7-liter and 6.6-liter V8s to replace the lower-displacement predecessors.
There’s a lot to fall in love with on the new 1500 trucks, like the fresh user interface inside which continues to support smartphone mirroring and allows Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to get rid of the biggest controversies GM has kicked off on some of its models. Alas, some folks just can’t be bothered with the modern trends – unless they’re on HD models.
So, a fan of the GMC Sierra HD has transformed their ritzy Denali pickup truck into something that looks great both at the farm, around the warehouse, and even at a glamping off-road location. Dressed in a very nice light-grey-blue hue and fitted with both chrome and gloss black plastic elements, the GMC Sierra Denali HD rides lifted on a set of matching and contrasting Gloss Black Vossen HFX-5 concave alloy wheels.
The latter start from just $525 each in the six-lug configuration, which is available with 17 through 24-inch diameters and 8.5 to 12-inch widths. However, this is the sturdier eight-lug configuration, which starts from $899 for each wheel and ranges from 22 to 24 inches in diameter and from 10 to 12 inches in width. Naturally, the GMC Sierra Denali HD may be quite ritzy in this presentation, but it never forgets that it also belongs on the off-road trails; thus it comes shod with massive all-terrain tires.
